title: A framework for spanning forest identities
summary: Identities of spanning forest polynomials can come from determinantal identities such as the classical Dodgson identity. They can also be useful in quantum field theory calculations, particularly the quadratic ones. To better understand the structure of spanning forest polynomial identities, we look at when identities on a given graph are generic for all graphs, we ask about dimensions of spaces of spanning forest identities indexed by certain parameters, and we set up a framework that we hope will be helpful for further progress in these directions.
